top_news.title: CDC vaccine policy recommendations grind to a halt under Health Secretary Kennedy
top_news.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s vaccine recommendation process has been blown up in the past year, and decision-making has ground to a halt. Efforts by vaccine-wary officials in President Donald Trump's administration to scale back shot recommendations have been put on hold. Federal guidance on new vaccines has stopped. And public discussion of vaccine policy questions that might cross political divides have diminished. Doctors’ groups that used to collaborate with the government have gone their own way. It’s more than an abstract policy discussion. The situation may be affecting whether people are getting the best available protection against vaccine-preventable diseases.

articles.title: CDC vaccine policy recommendations grind to a halt under Health Secretary Kennedy
articles.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s vaccine recommendation process has been blown up in the past year, and decision-making has ground to a halt. Efforts by vaccine-wary officials in President Donald Trump's administration to scale back shot recommendations have been put on hold. Federal guidance on new vaccines has stopped. And public discussion of vaccine policy questions that might cross political divides have diminished. Doctors’ groups that used to collaborate with the government have gone their own way. It’s more than an abstract policy discussion. The situation may be affecting whether people are getting the best available protection against vaccine-preventable diseases.
